## Analysis

**Critical finding: There is no fighter character visible in any of the four frames.**

What I actually see across all four sequential frames:

1. **Background only**: A dark rainy night scene — distant window lights (orange/teal), diagonal rain streaks, a light gray rooftop/ledge band, and dark structural cross-bracing below.

2. **No player figure**: No black silhouette, no cyan visor, no katana, no dash pose, no leg/arm anatomy — nothing.

3. **No ghost trail**: No afterimages, motion echoes, or cyan-tinted duplicates anywhere in frame. The only faint elements are ambiguous dark marks along the rooftop band (frame 1–3), which appear to be static environmental details (vents/antennas), not a character or trail.

4. **No forward displacement**: Since there's no lead element and no trailing ghosts, there is no leading/trailing relationship to verify.

### Checklist results

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| 1) Solid player leads, ghosts trail behind | ❌ Fail — no player, no ghosts |
| 2) Anatomy reads correctly in motion | ❌ Fail — nothing to evaluate |
| 3) Trail reads as speed, not glitch | ❌ Fail — trail absent entirely |

## Grade: **1/10** (fail)

The dash-in-motion cannot be scored because the subject is entirely missing — every frame captured the empty background. This looks like the player character failed to render, spawned off-screen, or was composited out of the capture. Recommendation: re-capture with the fighter actually on-screen and mid-dash before any animation-quality evaluation is possible.
